rationale: The food-truck strategy leads on capital efficiency: a 35000 truck with build-to-order stock and deposits needs far less upfront capital than a second site, while wholesale depends on a few buyers. Its weakness is weather and event risk, partly answered by deposits and the home pitch fallback.
human_judge: panel-judge implementer reasoned expectation for the v1.0 gate (NOT an independent external human judge; see docs/EVAL-v1.0.md)

amendments.note: Re-judged after the first gate run: the food-truck group has only two members whose target markets are disjoint (United Kingdom vs Australia). Under the A5 same-label rule, each member differs materially from the rest of its group, so BOTH are same-label dissent, not only the Australia member. Direction (food-truck / plurality) was already correct; only the dissent set is corrected. No judge code was changed to fit.
